---
name: Bug report
about: A concrete SDK or harness defect
title: ''
---

## Affected component and environment

SDK, protocol or harness? Include package version, source commit, runtime/OS and
provider/route. Report security concerns privately; see packages/sdk/SECURITY.md.

## Trigger and expected behavior

Give minimal reproduction steps and explain the expected and actual result.

## Evidence and consequence

Include isolated logs or a mock-provider reproduction. Remove secrets and owner
data. State whether the defect was reproduced or remains a concern.

## Acceptance criteria

State the behavior a focused fix and regression test must prove.
